Hi all — thanks for pulling this together. I pulled the invoice and the account history for ACME-5342. Summary below: 

- What happened: The self-serve promo credit (PLG-WELCOME-100) was issued the same day the account was created but our billing engine posts usage and tax on the current billing cycle and then posts credits as a separate negative line item. On the PDF you shared the negative credit line appears on page 2 but the accounting view (single-line summary) can make it look like VAT was charged on the gross usage amount.

- VAT treatment: For US-registered entities we do not collect VAT; for EU-based entities we issue credits that reduce the taxable base where local law requires. AcmeCorp is US-based (your billing address shows New York), so VAT is not applicable; the tax line on the invoice is a state sales tax that was applied by the invoice engine for one-time taxable services. That tax should be computed on the net after credits for some tax jurisdictions — ours is configured to do that when the credit posts on the same invoice, but there are edge cases when the credit posts on a subsequent invoice.

- Next steps I recommend: 
  1) We'll issue an off-cycle credit for PLG-WELCOME-100 that will create a negative line item dated 2026-11-28 and clearly show the adjusted taxable base.
  2) I'll flag accounting so they can provide a memo you can share with your AP team.
  3) If you need a formal credit memo PDF for your files I can generate that and resend.

Attachments referenced: acmecorp_invoice_20261126.pdf (we reviewed)

I'll create the credit now and update the thread when it's posted. Ben — feel free to confirm whether we should also add a 30-day trial extension for the team while we reconcile this.

Thanks,
